pages.title: Crippled
pages.text: Crippled reduces movement speed by 15% and prevents sprinting. Ogre Grunt bites and thrown Hunter's Spears can inflict it.$(br2)Its duration cannot be refreshed while already active, giving the victim a fixed window to endure.

pages.title: Dazed
pages.text: Dazed reduces movement speed by 20% and attack speed by 15%.$(br2)It is inflicted by the heaviest attacks used by Ogre Brutes and the Ogre King. When a large ogre commits to a slam, distance is the safest answer.

pages.title: Bleeding
pages.text: Bleeding deals periodic damage and releases red particles. Hunter's Spears enchanted with Barbed can apply it in melee or when thrown.$(br2)Higher Barbed levels increase its damage. Bleeding cannot be refreshed while already active.

pages.title: Bogfume Rage
pages.text: Bogfume Rage empowers ogres standing inside an Ogre Mage's poison fog. An empowered ogre deals 20% more damage and takes 15% less damage.$(br2)The effect is refreshed while the ogre remains in the fog. Break up the group or leave the cloud before engaging.
